text:
Diego S.: Hey all, Diego joining Sales Ops today. Running into a few provisioning things: Okta enroll says 'No authenticator apps found' when I scan QR with my phone (Pixel 6). Also my company email alias is diego.sales@redwood.com but 1Password invite went to diego@personalmail.com. Who handles rerouting invites?
IT Support: Welcome Diego! Quick check: did you scan the QR from the Okta web modal or from an email? Which authenticator app did you use?
Diego S.: Scanned from the web modal using Google Authenticator on Android 14. The app sees the account but Okta says 'Verification failed: device not trusted'.
People Ops: Congrats Diego! @it-support we'll need to look at device-trust policy. Also we'll reassign 1Password seat if the invite went to the wrong address. @security FYI for the device-trust exception.
Security: We can allow a 6-hour device-trust exception for personal devices after a quick device check. Diego, can you confirm you're on an up-to-date OS and that Play Protect is enabled?
Diego S.: Yes OS up to date, Play Protect on. I get a one-time code in the authenticator but Okta rejects it. Error in console: "OktaAuthError: Interaction_required - device not trusted"
Priya (eng): fwiw I once had this when Chrome had blocked third-party cookies for Okta domain. Try enabling cookies or use a new incognito window.
IT Support: Good tip. Also, Diego, can you try scanning the QR into Authy instead? It sometimes handles Android WebAuthn quirks better. I'm opening a ticket to temporarily add you to temp-device-trust for 6h and re-issuing the MFA enrollment.
onboard-bot: Provisioning status update: Okta: temp_device_trust request=open, GoogleWorkspace: invite_sent, 1Password: seat_misassigned target=diego.sales@redwood.com
Diego S.: Switched to Authy, completed MFA setup and received codes. Enrollment still errored once, then succeeded after a page refresh. Drive access now works. 1Password invite still at personal address.
IT Support: Reassigned 1Password seat to diego.sales@redwood.com and resent the invite. Check spam. Also sent you a short checklist DM to finalize device posture.
Diego S.: Invite arrived and I can sign in. Thanks for the fast help! One last Q: who do I ping for slack channel access to #sales-calls?
People Ops: Welcome aboard! For channel access DM Priya or ping #eng-ops if you need a workspace access change. Priya will add you to the Sales Ops roster.
Priya (eng): Invited you to #sales-calls and #sales-onboarding. Also dropped a link to the shared drive with onboarding docs.
Diego S.: Got the invites. All set — really appreciate the help :thumbsup:
Security: Note to team: mark this temp-device-trust exception as audited; I'll follow up on posture checks later.
People Ops: Great! Diego, if you want a company device, DM me and we'll start the shipment. Welcome again :tada:
